title: Unified Data Selection for LLM Reasoning
authors_zh: Xiaoyuan Li、Yubo Ma、Chengpeng Li、Fengbin Zhu、Yiyao Yu、Keqin Bao、Wenjie Wang、Fuli Feng、Dayiheng Liu
paper_type_zh: 跨阶段高熵数据选择研究
best_for_zh: 研究SFT、RFT、GRPO数据效率和不确定性筛选的读者
one_line: Unified Data Selection ranks reasoning trajectories by entropy concentrated at their highest-uncertainty tokens and applies the score to SFT, correctness-filtered RFT and online GRPO rollout selection.
Unified Data Selection以回答内最高熵0.5%词元的熵和排序轨迹，并将其用于SFT、正确性过滤RFT和在线GRPO选择。
why: It exposes a unified selection signal across three post-training stages and provides useful threshold, length and proxy-model ablations, but reuse still depends on undisclosed tokenizer details, correctness checks, record manifests and selected-data releases.
inclusion_reason: Unified Data Selection makes token-entropy ranking an explicit cross-stage recipe for selecting supervised demonstrations, correctness-filtered rejection-finetuning traces and online RL rollouts, while its missing tokenizer, verifier and record-level release contracts expose exactly the audit risks central to reasoning-data construction.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official arXiv v1, dated 21 May 2026, and the OpenReview record for ICLR 2026 Submission 8937 are the primary sources for this Card. OpenReview still describes the work as a submission, while the later arXiv version is an under-review preprint; no acceptance record was verified.

Reasoning-data selection is commonly specialized to one training stage: an offline demonstration filter for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), a correctness gate and sampler for rejection fine-tuning (RFT), or a rollout/batch policy for reinforcement learning (RL). The paper asks whether a single model-intrinsic uncertainty statistic can rank useful full-response trajectories across all three settings without training a separate reward model or judge.

The data objects are not a newly released dataset. They are existing prompt-response demonstrations for SFT, model-generated candidate solutions for RFT, and successful/failed online rollouts for GRPO. Each response is augmented conceptually with token-distribution entropies and a response-level High-Entropy Sum (HES); RFT and RL additionally require an external answer-correctness outcome. This makes the paper relevant to data_construction_open_release_recipes: it specifies a selection recipe over reasoning traces, while the missing record manifests, implementation, verifier contract, and selected/rejected releases keep the Card at L3 rather than establishing an open, reproducible data release.

本卡以2026年五月21日发布的官方arXiv v1以及ICLR 2026 Submission 8937的OpenReview记录为主要来源。OpenReview仍将其标为投稿,较晚的arXiv版本则是审稿中的预印本;未核验到接收记录。

推理数据选择通常针对单一训练阶段分别设计:SFT使用离线示范过滤器,RFT使用正确性门控与采样器,RL则使用rollout或批次选择策略。论文研究能否用同一个模型内生不确定性统计量,在不另行训练reward model或judge的情况下,对这三个阶段的完整回答轨迹排序。

其数据对象不是新发布的数据集,而是SFT中的既有提示-回答示范、RFT中的模型生成候选解,以及GRPO中的在线成功/失败rollout。每条回答在概念上附带词元分布熵和回答级High-Entropy Sum(HES);RFT与RL还需要外部答案正确性结果。因此该工作适合归入data_construction_open_release_recipes:它给出了面向推理轨迹的选择配方,但缺少记录清单、实现、verifier契约和接受/拒绝数据发布,故本卡保留L3,不能把它视为可开放复现的数据发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
For token position t, the paper computes entropy over the model vocabulary, H_t = -sum_j P_t(j) log P_t(j). Its main relative HES retains the top p fraction of token positions within one response and sums their entropies; the default is p = 0.005, i.e. the top 0.5% of that response's tokens. An absolute variant sums positions with H_t > 1.6, and AvgHE divides HES by the number of selected positions. The selector uses the cumulative high-uncertainty mass, not the mean uncertainty of the whole trace.

The same score is consumed differently at each stage. SFT ranks all demonstrations and keeps a top fraction (principally 20% for an efficiency test or 80% for a denoising test). RFT first removes incorrect candidates, then either keeps the highest-HES correct responses per query (k = 2, 4, or 8) or constructs a volume-matched global pool. RL divides rollouts into successful and failed pools, selects high-HES positives, and samples negatives; the best reported composition is high-HES positives plus random failures.

HES is therefore a selection signal rather than a correctness verifier, scalar task reward, or semantic quality label. The feedback contract is mixed: token-distribution uncertainty ranks trajectories, while an undisclosed answer checker supplies the success/failure predicate for RFT and RL. Keeping those two signals separate is essential because the paper's own entropy analysis shows that incorrect trajectories can have higher HES than correct ones.

对位置t处的词元,论文在模型词表上计算熵H_t = -sum_j P_t(j) log P_t(j)。主要的相对HES在单条回答内部选取熵最高的p比例词元位置并求和;默认p = 0.005,即该回答内最高的0.5%词元。绝对版本对H_t > 1.6的位置求和,AvgHE则用HES除以被选位置数。该选择器使用高不确定性质量的累积和,而不是整条轨迹的平均不确定性。

同一分数在各阶段的消费方式不同。SFT对全部示范排序并保留前一部分,主要以20%作效率测试、以80%作去噪测试。RFT先移除错误候选,再按问题保留HES最高的正确回答(k = 2、4或8),或构造数据量匹配的全局池。RL把rollout分为成功池和失败池,选择高HES正样本并采样负样本;报告中表现最好的组合是高HES正样本加随机失败样本。

因此,HES是选择信号,而不是正确性verifier、标量任务reward或语义质量标签。其反馈契约是混合的:词元分布不确定性用于轨迹排序,未披露的答案检查器则为RFT和RL提供成功/失败判定。必须把两类信号分开,因为论文自身的熵分析显示,错误轨迹的HES可能高于正确轨迹。

title: Method
方法
html:
For SFT, the paper forms a Mixture-of-Thoughts pool spanning Math, Code, and STEM from OpenR1-Math, Open-Math-Reasoning, Codeforces-CoT, and the Llama-Nemotron STEM subset. Appendix E says approximately 100,000 examples are randomly sampled from source collections for each domain, but it does not publish the sampled identifiers or immutable source revisions. Qwen3-8B-Base is the main SFT model; a Qwen3-0.6B proxy is also tested for scoring data later used to train the 8B model. Offline HES scoring requires a forward pass over each stored response to obtain token distributions.

For RFT, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B generates 32 candidate responses for every DeepScaleR query. Candidates are checked for final-answer correctness before HES ranking. Per-query selection takes up to k highest-HES correct responses for k = 2, 4, or 8; if fewer than k are correct, all correct responses are retained. Global selection pools all correct responses and retains the highest-HES N, with N matched to the corresponding per-query data volume. The exact candidate decoding settings and the correctness checker, normalization, tolerance, and failure policy are not disclosed.

For RL, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B runs GRPO using verl. The reported configuration uses a maximum generation length of 8,192, temperature 0.6, 32 rollouts per query, 3 epochs, and 628 steps. A reduced update batch contains half the rollout data, split between positive and negative pools. The main strategy takes highest-HES successful rollouts and random failed rollouts. Entropy is computed from logits already produced during generation; this avoids an additional model forward pass, although it still requires vocabulary-wide entropy operations and logit handling.

SFT and RFT use AdamW with learning rate 4e-5, cosine decay, 0.1 warm-up, global batch size 64, and 3 epochs. Evaluation covers AIME24/25, HMMT23/24/25, Olym-MATH, GPQA-Diamond, and LiveCodeBench; the paper reports evaluation temperature 0.6 and maximum generation length 32,768. Appendix F reports all experiments used one node with 8 NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs and about 500 GPU hours in total.

The only verified paper-specific artifacts are the arXiv paper, its official BibTeX endpoint, and the OpenReview submission record. No official code repository, selected-data files, HES score tables, rollout dump, model checkpoint, project page, or Hugging Face release was found. The paper names open-r1 and verl as implementation substrates and lists upstream dataset/model licenses, but those upstream resources are not a release of this paper's transformed records.

SFT部分从OpenR1-Math、Open-Math-Reasoning、Codeforces-CoT和Llama-Nemotron STEM子集构成覆盖Math、Code与STEM的Mixture-of-Thoughts池。附录E称每个领域从来源集合随机抽取约100,000条样本,但未发布抽样标识符或不可变来源版本。主SFT模型是Qwen3-8B-Base;论文还用Qwen3-0.6B代理模型为随后训练8B模型的数据评分。离线HES评分需要对每条存储回答执行一次前向计算,以取得词元分布。

RFT部分由DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B为每个DeepScaleR问题生成32个候选回答。候选先检查最终答案正确性,再按HES排序。按问题选择在k = 2、4或8时最多保留k条HES最高的正确回答;若正确回答少于k,则全部保留。全局选择汇总所有正确回答并保留HES最高的N条,其中N与对应按问题设置的数据量匹配。候选解码设置以及正确性检查器、归一化、容差和失败策略均未披露。

RL部分由DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B基于verl运行GRPO。报告配置为最大生成长度8,192、温度0.6、每问题32个rollout、训练3个epoch、共628步。缩减后的更新批次使用一半rollout数据,并分成正负两个池。主要策略选择HES最高的成功rollout和随机失败rollout。熵直接利用生成时已有logits计算,因此不需要额外的模型前向,但仍需执行词表范围的熵运算并处理logits。

SFT和RFT均使用AdamW,学习率4e-5、cosine decay、warm-up比例0.1、全局batch size 64、训练3个epoch。评估覆盖AIME24/25、HMMT23/24/25、Olym-MATH、GPQA-Diamond和LiveCodeBench;论文报告的评估温度为0.6,最大生成长度为32,768。附录F称全部实验在单节点8张NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU上完成,总计约500 GPU小时。

已核验的论文专用artifact只有arXiv论文、其官方BibTeX端点和OpenReview投稿记录。未找到官方代码仓库、选后数据文件、HES分数表、rollout转储、模型checkpoint、项目页或Hugging Face发布。论文把open-r1和verl列为实现底座,并列出上游数据集/模型许可证,但这些上游资源不等于本文转换后记录的发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The evidence is downstream training performance under the authors' experimental setup, not direct validation that HES labels semantic correctness or that the selected records form a high-quality reusable dataset. In the main Math SFT table, the average score is 31.83 for the full set, 31.34 for the highest-HES 20%, 34.61 for the highest-HES 80%, and 11.75 for the lowest-HES 20%. The cross-domain table is not uniform: on GPQA-Diamond, highest-HES 20% reaches 51.96 versus 47.66 for the full set, whereas on LiveCodeBench it reaches 54.43 versus 58.76; highest-HES 80% reaches 61.65 on LiveCodeBench.

RFT gains are positive on the reported averages but modest and configuration-dependent. For per-query k = 2, 4, and 8, highest-HES averages 30.10, 30.20, and 30.13, compared with random at 28.92, 28.64, and 29.33. Global selection sometimes narrows prompt coverage, and per-benchmark results are not uniformly higher. The paper's interpretation that per-query selection benefits from coverage is plausible, but no released manifest permits a record-level diversity audit.

In RL, Table 7 reports average scores of 18.34 for the full batch, 17.51 for random positives/random negatives, 19.26 for high-HES positives/random negatives, and 17.28 for high-HES positives/low-HES negatives. This supports the narrower claim that both positive selection and the negative-sampling distribution matter in this setup; it does not show that low-HES failures are universally less useful or that HES alone specifies the training reward.

Supplementary experiments repeat the comparison on OpenR1-Math-220k, Open-Math-Reasoning, another Qwen size, and a Llama-based RFT model. The 0.6B proxy-selected top 20% gives 30.20 versus 31.34 for 8B self-selection in the main Math average. Length-stratified results also show an important boundary: the highest-versus-lowest HES gap is large for short and medium traces but only 25.19 versus 24.91 for long traces. Figures 1 and 6 report higher mean HES for incorrect than correct trajectories, reinforcing that HES tracks cumulative uncertainty/complexity rather than correctness.

The tables report Average@16 for most reasoning evaluation and Average@10 for LiveCodeBench, but no confidence intervals, independent training seeds, or released run logs are provided. Benchmark gains therefore evaluate the selector under one disclosed recipe; they are not proof of dataset quality, verifier reliability, contamination safety, or release completeness.

证据来自作者实验设置下的下游训练表现,并非直接证明HES能够标注语义正确性,也不能证明选出的记录构成高质量、可复用的数据集。在主Math SFT表中,全量数据平均分为31.83,最高HES 20%为31.34,最高HES 80%为34.61,最低HES 20%为11.75。跨领域结果并不一致:GPQA-Diamond上最高HES 20%为51.96,全量为47.66;LiveCodeBench上同一子集为54.43,全量为58.76,而最高HES 80%达到61.65。

RFT在报告的平均分上取得正向但较小且依配置而变的增益。按问题选择k = 2、4、8时,最高HES平均分分别为30.10、30.20、30.13,随机基线分别为28.92、28.64、29.33。全局选择可能缩小提示覆盖范围,各单项benchmark也并非全部提升。论文把按问题选择的优势解释为覆盖率收益,这一解释合理,但没有发布清单可用于记录级多样性审计。

RL的表7报告:全批平均18.34,随机正/随机负17.51,高HES正/随机负19.26,高HES正/低HES负17.28。这支持一个较窄的结论:在该设置中,正样本选择与负样本分布都重要;它不能证明低HES失败样本在所有场景都更无用,也不能证明HES本身定义了完整训练reward。

补充实验在OpenR1-Math-220k、Open-Math-Reasoning、另一种Qwen规模和Llama系RFT模型上重复了比较。主Math平均分中,0.6B代理选择的前20%得到30.20，8B自选择得到31.34。按长度分层的结果也揭示重要边界:短、中轨迹中最高与最低HES差距较大,但长轨迹仅为25.19对24.91。图1和图6报告错误轨迹的平均HES高于正确轨迹,进一步说明HES反映累积不确定性或复杂度,而不是正确性。

表格对多数推理评估报告Average@16,对LiveCodeBench报告Average@10,但未提供置信区间、独立训练seed或公开run log。因此,benchmark提升只评估了一个已披露配方下的选择器,不能作为数据集质量、verifier可靠性、去污染安全性或发布完整性的证明。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior data-selection baselines in the paper include random sampling, response length, heuristic difficulty, average token entropy, total entropy, and average entropy over high-entropy tokens. The related-work discussion also contrasts HES with gradient/influence-based selection and selectors that need a trained auxiliary model or a powerful LLM judge. Against these baselines, the specific change is to rank token positions within each response, retain only a sparse high-entropy tail, and sum rather than average its entropy.

The main direction signal is cross-stage reuse of that same statistic. Offline SFT treats HES as a demonstration-ranking feature; correctness-filtered RFT uses it after a programmatic answer outcome; online GRPO uses it to compose successful and failed rollout subsets. The RL design additionally separates the positive and negative policies instead of applying one symmetric rank rule to both pools.

What is not new is equally important: the work does not introduce token entropy, data pruning, rejection sampling, answer verification, GRPO, the upstream datasets, or a new open corpus. It also does not establish that high entropy is intrinsically good. Its own analysis associates higher HES with incorrect responses before correctness filtering, so the reusable contribution is a model-conditioned complexity/selection feature plus stage-specific gates, not a universal quality label.

For reuse, a faithful implementation must test the relative percentile, absolute threshold, and AvgHE variants; retain prompt-coverage statistics; and compare random, length, difficulty, and full-data controls under matched training and evaluation budgets. Without those checks, an apparent gain could come from correctness filtering, prompt coverage, batch composition, model calibration, or training-budget changes rather than HES itself.

论文中的既有数据选择基线包括随机采样、回答长度、启发式难度、平均词元熵、总熵和高熵词元平均熵。相关工作还把HES与梯度/影响函数选择,以及需要训练辅助模型或强LLM judge的选择器对比。在这些基线之上,具体变化是先在每条回答内部对词元位置排序,只保留稀疏的高熵尾部,并对其熵求和而不是求平均。

主要方向信号是同一统计量的跨阶段复用。离线SFT把HES作为示范排序特征;正确性过滤RFT在程序化答案结果之后使用HES;在线GRPO用HES组成成功与失败rollout子集。RL设计还为正样本池和负样本池采用不同策略,而不是对两者套用一个对称排序规则。

同样需要明确哪些不是新贡献:该工作没有提出词元熵、数据剪枝、拒绝采样、答案验证、GRPO、上游数据集或新的开放语料,也没有证明高熵本身天然有益。其分析在正确性过滤前把更高HES与错误回答联系起来,因此可复用贡献是模型条件化的复杂度/选择特征及分阶段门控,而不是通用质量标签。

复用时,忠实实现必须检验相对百分位、绝对阈值和AvgHE变体,保留提示覆盖统计,并在匹配训练与评估预算下比较随机、长度、难度和全量控制。若缺少这些检查,表面增益可能来自正确性过滤、提示覆盖、批次组成、模型校准或训练预算变化,而不一定来自HES本身。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• No paper-specific code, selected SFT/RFT corpus, online rollout data, HES score file, checkpoint, or immutable experiment manifest was verified. The paper names open-r1, verl, and upstream datasets, but does not publish the transformations that connect source records to reported subsets.
  • The RFT/RL correctness contract is incomplete: answer extraction, normalization, tolerances, checker implementation, timeouts, exceptions, and per-candidate decisions are unknown. HES cannot replace this missing verifier because incorrect traces can score higher than correct traces.
  • Relative HES is implementation-sensitive. Tokenizer and model revisions, vocabulary scope, precision, log base, special-token handling, percentile rounding for short responses, and tie-breaking are not specified completely. The top 0.5% rule also selects a length-dependent number of positions, and the long-trace ablation shows only a small highest-versus-lowest gap.
  • The claim of zero extra online inference overhead means no extra model forward pass. Entropy is still an O(vocabulary) operation per token and may require logit retention, transfer, and aggregation. No measured wall-clock latency, memory, communication, energy, or monetary cost is reported; the proxy model's approximately 1/13 inference-cost claim is likewise not tied to a measured hardware accounting.
  • Exact sampled IDs, upstream revisions, random seeds, stage-wise yields, train/evaluation overlap, and exact/near/semantic decontamination checks are undisclosed. LiveCodeBench's upstream contamination-resistant design does not audit overlap across this paper's full mixture.
  • The empirical scope is dominated by mathematical reasoning, with one STEM and one code evaluation surface in the main cross-domain table. Results do not establish transfer to other tokenizers, languages, dialogue, agent trajectories, or non-verifiable domains. Reported evaluation samples multiple outputs, but training-run variance and independent seeds are not supplied.
  • The paper itself leaves agentic planning untested, warns that HES may lose discriminative power when uncertainty is distributed throughout open-ended outputs, and computes HES only once before training instead of evaluating dynamic curricula or periodic rescoring.
  • The paper reports upstream licenses, not a license for a paper-specific selected dataset because no such dataset was verified. OpenReview lists 8 authors, while arXiv v1 lists 9 and adds Fengbin Zhu; the records also differ in ordering. Citation and venue status must therefore be version-pinned, and the work should not be described as accepted at ICLR 2026.

• 未核验到论文专用代码、选后SFT/RFT语料、在线rollout数据、HES分数文件、checkpoint或不可变实验清单。论文列出open-r1、verl和上游数据集,但没有发布连接来源记录与报告子集的转换过程。
  • RFT/RL的正确性契约不完整:答案抽取、归一化、容差、检查器实现、超时、异常处理和逐候选决策均未知。HES不能替代这一缺失verifier,因为错误轨迹可能比正确轨迹得到更高分。
  • 相对HES对实现细节敏感。tokenizer与模型版本、词表范围、数值精度、对数底、特殊词元处理、短回答的百分位舍入和并列处理均未完整说明。最高0.5%规则选取的位置数也随长度变化,长轨迹消融中最高与最低HES差距很小。
  • "在线零额外推理开销"只表示不需要额外模型前向。每个词元仍需执行O(词表大小)的熵运算,并可能需要logit保留、传输与聚合。论文未报告实测墙钟时间、内存、通信、能耗或货币成本;代理模型约1/13推理成本的说法同样没有对应的实测硬件核算。
  • 精确抽样ID、上游版本、随机seed、分阶段产出数、训练/评估重叠,以及精确/近重复/语义去污染检查均未披露。LiveCodeBench上游的抗污染设计不能替代对本文完整混合数据的重叠审计。
  • 实证范围以数学推理为主,主跨领域表中仅有一个STEM和一个代码评估面。结果不能证明可迁移到其他tokenizer、语言、对话、agent轨迹或不可程序验证领域。评估虽对多次输出取平均,但没有提供训练运行方差和独立seed。
  • 论文自身也明确未测试agentic planning,并警告当开放式输出的不确定性均匀分布时,HES的区分力可能下降;当前HES只在训练前静态计算一次,没有评估动态curriculum或周期性重评分。
  • 论文报告的是上游许可证;由于未核验到论文专用选后数据集,也不存在其专用数据许可证。OpenReview列8位作者,arXiv v1列9位并新增Fengbin Zhu,排序也有差异。因此引用和venue状态必须固定版本,不能把该工作描述为已被ICLR 2026接收。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned data_construction_open_release_recipes track, the paper is useful as a compact recipe for converting model uncertainty into a trace-selection field across three construction stages. It helps a builder ask a concrete question before scaling data volume: should the retained object be a demonstration, a correctness-filtered candidate, or a successful/failed rollout, and which independent predicate authorizes it to enter training?

An auditable SFT record should preserve the source-record ID and revision, prompt, full response, scoring model/tokenizer revision, per-token entropy or a reproducible summary, HES variant and parameters, rank, retention threshold, accepted/rejected decision, and domain/length stratum. RFT additionally needs all 32 candidates, the exact correctness decision, per-query versus global pool membership, k, prompt coverage, and the final selected set. RL needs rollout logits or reproducible entropy summaries, success/failure reward, positive/negative sampler, full and reduced batch membership, policy revision, temperature, generation budget, and training step.

The recipe can support SFT subset selection, post-correctness RFT ranking, and GRPO batch composition. It should not be reused as an answer verifier or promoted to a reward without separately testing whether the policy can exploit uncertainty, verbosity, tokenization, or calibration artifacts. The most informative follow-up release would include both accepted and rejected records, because the RL ablation shows that the distribution of failed trajectories materially changes the result.

For atlas users, the paper is also a good audit example: downstream gains can motivate a selection hypothesis, but they do not establish data quality. A reusable release would need immutable lineage, complete verifier decisions, score computation code, cost measurements, decontamination evidence, and licenses for the transformed records.

对于指定的data_construction_open_release_recipes类别,该论文可作为一个紧凑配方,展示如何在三个构造阶段把模型不确定性转化为轨迹选择字段。它促使构建者在扩大数据量前回答一个具体问题:要保留的对象究竟是示范、经过正确性过滤的候选,还是成功/失败rollout;又由哪个独立判定允许它进入训练?

可审计的SFT记录应保留来源记录ID与版本、提示、完整回答、评分模型/tokenizer版本、逐词元熵或可复现摘要、HES变体与参数、排名、保留阈值、接受/拒绝决定及领域/长度分层。RFT还需保留全部32个候选、精确正确性决定、按问题或全局池归属、k、提示覆盖和最终选集。RL则需保留rollout logits或可复现熵摘要、成功/失败reward、正负采样器、全批与缩减批次归属、policy版本、温度、生成预算和训练step。

该配方可用于SFT子集选择、正确性过滤后的RFT排序和GRPO批次组成。它不应被直接当作答案verifier,也不应在未单独测试policy是否会利用不确定性、冗长度、tokenization或校准伪影前升级为reward。最有信息量的后续发布应同时包含接受与拒绝记录,因为RL消融表明失败轨迹的分布会实质性改变结果。

对atlas读者而言,该论文也是一个合适的审计案例:下游增益可以支持一个选择假设,但不能证明数据质量。可复用发布还需要不可变lineage、完整verifier决策、分数计算代码、成本实测、去污染证据和转换后记录的许可证。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read "top 0.5%" as token positions inside each individual response, not the top 0.5% of dataset records.
  • Keep HES and correctness as separate fields: HES ranks uncertainty/complexity, while an external checker defines RFT/RL success.
  • Compare the stage-specific object: SFT demonstrations, 32-candidate RFT pools, and positive/negative GRPO rollouts are not interchangeable records.
  • Treat 31.34 versus 31.83 in the main Math SFT average and 19.26 versus 18.34 in RL as setup-specific evidence, not universal data-quality proof.
  • Audit prompt coverage and failed-trajectory sampling: per-query RFT often beats global selection, random negatives beat low-HES negatives in the reported RL ablation, and the nine-author arXiv v1 versus eight-author OpenReview record remains a version mismatch; no ICLR acceptance or paper-specific release was verified.

• "最高0.5%"指每条回答内部的词元位置,不是数据集记录中排名最高的0.5%。
  • 将HES与正确性保留为两个独立字段:HES排序不确定性或复杂度,外部检查器定义RFT/RL是否成功。
  • 区分各阶段对象:SFT示范、含32个候选的RFT池和GRPO正负rollout不是可互换的记录。
  • 将主Math SFT平均分31.34对31.83、RL中19.26对18.34视为特定设置证据,而不是通用数据质量证明。
  • 审计提示覆盖和失败轨迹采样:报告中按问题RFT常优于全局选择,RL消融中随机负样本优于低HES负样本;同时固定九作者arXiv v1,并把八作者OpenReview投稿保留为版本差异,因为尚未核验到ICLR接收或论文专用发布。

value.html: SFT experiments draw mathematical, code and STEM prompts from a Mixture-of-Thoughts pool built from OpenR1-Math, Open-Math-Reasoning, Codeforces-CoT and Llama-Nemotron STEM collections. RFT and RL experiments use DeepScaleR mathematical prompts. Exact sampled record identifiers and immutable source revisions are not disclosed.

value_zh.html: SFT 实验从由 OpenR1-Math、Open-Math-Reasoning、Codeforces-CoT 与 Llama-Nemotron STEM 集合构建的 Mixture-of-Thoughts 池中抽取数学、代码与 STEM 提示。RFT 与 RL 实验使用 DeepScaleR 数学提示。精确采样记录标识符与不可变来源修订未披露。

value.html: A candidate record consists of a reasoning response ending in an answer, plus token-level next-token distributions used to compute entropy. RFT adds a correctness outcome before HES ranking; RL separates successful and failed rollout trajectories and selects a composed positive/negative training batch.

value_zh.html: 一条候选记录由以答案结尾的推理回复，外加用于计算熵的 token 级 next-token 分布组成。RFT 在 HES 排序前加入正确性结果；RL 分离成功与失败的 rollout 轨迹，并选择组合的正/负训练 batch。

value.html: Existing reasoning demonstrations supply the SFT candidate traces. DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B generates 32 RFT candidates per DeepScaleR prompt, while DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B generates 32 online GRPO rollouts per prompt in the RL experiment.

value_zh.html: 既有推理示范提供 SFT 候选轨迹。DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 为每个 DeepScaleR 提示生成 32 个 RFT 候选，而 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 在 RL 实验中为每个提示生成 32 条在线 GRPO rollout。

items: prompt and full reasoning response
token-level predictive entropy along the response
high-entropy token set selected by within-response percentile or an absolute threshold
summed high-entropy score HES and optional average high entropy AvgHE
answer correctness outcome for RFT and RL
per-query or global selection rank for RFT
successful or failed rollout group and positive/negative sampling strategy for RL
提示与完整推理回复
沿回复的 token 级预测熵
按回复内百分位或绝对阈值选出的高熵 token 集合
求和高熵分数 HES 与可选平均高熵 AvgHE
RFT 与 RL 的答案正确性结果
RFT 的逐查询或全局选择排名
RL 的成功或失败 rollout 组与正/负采样策略

value.html: Offline teacher-forced model scoring supplies token probabilities for SFT and RFT selection. Online rollout logits already produced during GRPO generation supply RL entropy values. The exact tokenizer contract, entropy implementation, score serialization format and correctness-verifier implementation are not disclosed.

value_zh.html: 离线 teacher-forced 模型打分为 SFT 与 RFT 选择提供 token 概率。GRPO 生成期间已产生的在线 rollout logits 提供 RL 熵值。精确 tokenizer 契约、熵实现、分数序列化格式与正确性验证器实现未披露。

value.html: HES is an intrinsic uncertainty-based selection score, not a correctness verifier. RFT first filters to correct trajectories and then ranks them by HES. RL uses rollout success/failure outcomes and obtains the strongest reported result by combining high-HES successful trajectories with randomly sampled failed trajectories; the exact answer-checking implementation is unknown.

value_zh.html: HES 是内在的基于不确定性的选择分数，不是正确性验证器。RFT 先过滤到正确轨迹再按 HES 排序。RL 使用 rollout 成功/失败结果，并通过将高 HES 成功轨迹与随机采样的失败轨迹结合获得所报告的最强结果；精确答案检查实现未知。

value.html: SFT selects the top fraction of candidate demonstrations by HES. RFT keeps up to k highest-HES correct responses per prompt or selects a global HES-ranked volume-matched pool. RL constructs a reduced GRPO batch from selected successful and failed rollouts; benchmark answer correctness is used for reported evaluation.

value_zh.html: SFT 按 HES 选择候选示范的顶部比例。RFT 每个提示保留至多 k 条最高 HES 正确回复，或选择全局 HES 排序的数据量匹配池。RL 从所选成功与失败 rollout 构造缩减的 GRPO batch；所报告评测使用基准答案正确性。

value.html: Qwen3-8B-Base is the main SFT model. DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B is used for RFT, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B is used for the GRPO experiment. A Qwen-family 0.6B proxy is also evaluated for lower-cost SFT selection.

value_zh.html: Qwen3-8B-Base 是主 SFT 模型。RFT 使用 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B，GRPO 实验使用 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B。亦评测 Qwen 族 0.6B 代理用于较低成本的 SFT 选择。

value.html: No single external teacher contract is specified. SFT scores existing demonstrations, whereas the RFT and RL base policies generate their own candidate trajectories. Upstream datasets can themselves contain synthetic teacher traces, but exact teacher lineage is not unified or pinned by this paper.

value_zh.html: 未指定单一外部教师契约。SFT 为既有示范打分，而 RFT 与 RL 基座策略生成其自身候选轨迹。上游数据集本身可含合成教师轨迹，但精确教师谱系未被本文统一或钉扎。

value.html: For each response token, compute predictive entropy over the model vocabulary. The primary relative HES sums entropy at tokens in the top 0.5% of that response's entropy ranking; an absolute variant sums entropy above tau=1.6, and AvgHE divides the sum by the number of selected high-entropy tokens.

value_zh.html: 对每个回复 token，在模型词表上计算预测熵。主相对 HES 将该回复熵排名前 0.5% 的 tokens 上的熵求和；绝对变体对高于 tau=1.6 的熵求和，AvgHE 将总和除以所选高熵 tokens 的数量。

value.html: RFT samples 32 responses for each DeepScaleR prompt and evaluates per-query top-k settings k=2, 4 and 8; prompts with fewer than k correct responses contribute all correct responses. Global selection pools correct responses across prompts and matches the per-query data volume. RL samples 32 rollouts per prompt at temperature 0.6 and selects only 50% of the rollout data for the reduced batch.

value_zh.html: RFT 为每个 DeepScaleR 提示采样 32 条回复，并评测逐查询 top-k 设置 k=2、4 与 8；正确回复少于 k 的提示贡献全部正确回复。全局选择跨提示汇集正确回复并匹配逐查询数据量。RL 以温度 0.6 为每个提示采样 32 条 rollout，并仅为缩减 batch 选择 50% 的 rollout 数据。

value.html: 0.6 for the reported GRPO rollout experiment; a complete decoding-temperature contract for every SFT/RFT scoring or generation path is not disclosed.

value_zh.html: 所报告 GRPO rollout 实验为 0.6；每一 SFT/RFT 打分或生成路径的完整解码温度契约未披露。

value.html: SFT ranks complete demonstrations by relative HES and retains the top rho, using rho=0.2 for efficiency and rho=0.8 for denoising studies. RFT discards incorrect responses before selecting high-HES correct trajectories. RL compares positive/negative rollout samplers and reports Pos-High plus Neg-Rand as strongest on average.

value_zh.html: SFT 按相对 HES 对完整示范排序并保留顶部 rho，效率研究用 rho=0.2，去噪研究用 rho=0.8。RFT 在选择高 HES 正确轨迹前丢弃不正确回复。RL 比较正/负 rollout 采样器，并报告 Pos-High 加 Neg-Rand 平均最强。

value.html: Relative HES uses the top 0.5% entropy-ranked tokens in each trace. The paper argues that online RL scoring needs no extra model forward pass because rollout logits are already available, but it does not report measured entropy-computation latency, memory, hardware time or monetary cost.

value_zh.html: 相对 HES 使用每条轨迹中熵排名前 0.5% 的 tokens。论文主张在线 RL 打分不需要额外的模型前向传播，因为 rollout logits 已可用，但未报告测得的熵计算延迟、内存、硬件时间或货币成本。

value.html: SFT and RFT use AdamW with learning rate 4e-5, cosine scheduling, 0.1 warmup, global batch size 64 and three epochs. RL uses verl GRPO with maximum generation length 8192, 32 rollouts per prompt, temperature 0.6 and three epochs over 628 steps.

value_zh.html: SFT 与 RFT 使用 AdamW，学习率 4e-5、余弦调度、0.1 warmup、全局 batch size 64 与三个 epochs。RL 使用 verl GRPO，最大生成长度 8192、每个提示 32 条 rollout、温度 0.6，以及 628 步上的三个 epochs。

value.html: The SFT pool combines OpenR1-Math, Open-Math-Reasoning, Codeforces-CoT and Llama-Nemotron STEM through Mixture-of-Thoughts; the paper describes sampling approximately 100,000 examples from the source collections for each of the Math, Code and STEM domains. RFT and RL use DeepScaleR. Exact selected IDs, HES scores and rejected-record manifests are not released.

value_zh.html: SFT 池通过 Mixture-of-Thoughts 结合 OpenR1-Math、Open-Math-Reasoning、Codeforces-CoT 与 Llama-Nemotron STEM；论文描述从源集合为 Math、Code 与 STEM 各域采样约 100,000 条样例。RFT 与 RL 使用 DeepScaleR。精确所选 IDs、HES 分数与被拒记录清单未发布。

value.html: The exact SFT sample manifest, random seeds, dataset snapshots and train/evaluation overlap ledger are unknown. RFT per-query selection preserves prompt coverage when correct candidates exist, whereas global selection can concentrate trajectories on fewer prompts. Stage-wise candidate, correctness-filter and retention counts are not reported.

value_zh.html: 精确 SFT 样本清单、随机种子、数据集快照与 train/评测重叠账本未知。当存在正确候选时，RFT 逐查询选择保留提示覆盖，而全局选择可能将轨迹集中到更少提示上。分阶段候选、正确性过滤与保留计数未报告。

value.html: unknown. No paper-specific exact, near-duplicate or semantic-overlap procedure is disclosed across the mixed SFT sources, DeepScaleR prompts and evaluation suites. LiveCodeBench is described upstream as contamination-resistant, but that does not constitute a unified audit for this paper's training mixture.

value_zh.html: 未知。未披露跨混合 SFT 来源、DeepScaleR 提示与评测套件的论文特定精确、近重复或语义重叠程序。LiveCodeBench 在上游被描述为抗污染，但这不构成本文训练混合物的统一审计。

items: HES measures model uncertainty, not semantic correctness. The paper observes that incorrect trajectories can have higher HES than correct trajectories, so high-HES selection without a separate correctness contract can prefer failures.
The exact RFT/RL correctness verifier, answer normalization, tolerance and failure policy are not disclosed. Correctness-filtered selection therefore cannot be reproduced or audited record by record.

Relative HES depends on tokenization, vocabulary probabilities, special-token handling, percentile rounding and tie behavior, none of which receive a tokenizer-sensitivity study or complete implementation contract.

Summing the top within-trace entropy fraction still changes the number of contributing tokens with response length. Length-stratified results support the method most clearly for medium and short traces, while the reported long-trace top-versus-bottom gap is small.

The paper sweeps high-entropy ratios 0.005, 0.05, 0.5 and 1.0 and compares an absolute threshold tau=1.6, but a best setting on the reported mixtures does not establish transfer to different tokenizers, model calibrations or domains.

Global RFT selection can sacrifice query coverage by selecting multiple high-HES traces from a smaller prompt subset; per-query selection avoids this concentration but depends on how many correct samples each prompt produces.

Random failed trajectories outperform low-HES failed trajectories in the reported RL composition. This shows that the negative-data distribution materially affects results and that HES alone does not define a complete training-data recipe.
The claim of no additional forward passes for online HES does not quantify the O(vocabulary) entropy operations, logit retention, communication or memory overhead.
The 0.6B proxy reduces selection inference cost according to the paper, but the reported 1/13 ratio is not accompanied by measured hardware, wall-clock, energy or monetary accounting.

No official paper-specific code, selected SFT/RFT data, rollout data, failed trajectories, HES score tables, tokenizer configuration or checkpoints were verified, limiting independent reproduction and open-release auditability.

OpenReview lists eight authors, while the later arXiv version lists nine authors, adds Fengbin Zhu and changes the order of Keqin Bao and Yiyao Yu. Consumers should pin the cited version rather than assume identical authorship metadata.
HES 衡量模型不确定性，而非语义正确性。论文观察到不正确轨迹的 HES 可以高于正确轨迹，因此没有单独正确性契约的高 HES 选择可能偏好失败。
精确 RFT/RL 正确性验证器、答案规范化、容差与失败策略未披露。因此经正确性过滤的选择无法逐记录复现或审计。
相对 HES 取决于 tokenization、词表概率、特殊 token 处理、百分位舍入与平局行为，其中无一获得 tokenizer 敏感性研究或完整实现契约。
对轨迹内顶部熵比例求和仍会使贡献 tokens 的数量随回复长度变化。长度分层结果对中短轨迹最清楚地支持该方法，而所报告的长轨迹顶部对底部差距很小。
论文扫描高熵比例 0.005、0.05、0.5 与 1.0，并比较绝对阈值 tau=1.6，但所报告混合物上的最佳设置并不确立向不同 tokenizers、模型校准或领域的迁移。
全局 RFT 选择可通过从较小提示子集选择多条高 HES 轨迹而牺牲查询覆盖；逐查询选择避免这种集中，但取决于每个提示产生多少正确样本。
在所报告的 RL 组成中，随机失败轨迹优于低 HES 失败轨迹。这表明负数据分布实质影响结果，且单凭 HES 不能定义完整训练数据配方。
在线 HES 无额外前向传播的主张并未量化 O(vocabulary) 熵运算、logit 保留、通信或内存开销。
据论文，0.6B 代理降低选择推断成本，但所报告的 1/13 比率未附带测得的硬件、墙钟、能量或货币核算。
未核验到官方论文特定代码、所选 SFT/RFT 数据、rollout 数据、失败轨迹、HES 分数表、tokenizer 配置或 checkpoints，限制了独立复现与公开发布可审计性。
OpenReview 列出八位作者，而较后的 arXiv 版本列出九位作者，加入 Fengbin Zhu 并改变 Keqin Bao 与 Yiyao Yu 的顺序。消费者应钉扎所引版本，而非假定作者元数据相同。

value.html: The arXiv and OpenReview paper records use CC BY 4.0. The paper lists upstream licenses including Apache-2.0 for OpenR1-Math and Mixture-of-Thoughts, CC BY 4.0 for Open-Math-Reasoning and MIT for DeepScaleR. No paper-specific selected dataset, code repository or artifact license is available because no such release was verified.

value_zh.html: arXiv 与 OpenReview 论文记录使用 CC BY 4.0。论文列出上游许可，包括 OpenR1-Math 与 Mixture-of-Thoughts 的 Apache-2.0、Open-Math-Reasoning 的 CC BY 4.0 与 DeepScaleR 的 MIT。无论文特定所选数据集、代码仓库或产物许可可用，因为未核验到此类发布。

value.html: Candidate reasoning traces are scored by a model's token entropy, reduced to a response-level HES, and ranked for downstream SFT, correctness-filtered RFT or online GRPO batch construction. The current paper does not publish record-level source IDs, tokenizer/model revision, score files, accepted and rejected lists, correctness decisions or rollout lineage needed to reconstruct these transformations exactly.

value_zh.html: 候选推理轨迹由模型的 token 熵打分，归约为回复级 HES，并为下游 SFT、经正确性过滤的 RFT 或在线 GRPO batch 构造排序。当前论文未发布精确重建这些变换所需的记录级来源 IDs、tokenizer/模型修订、分数文件、接受与拒绝列表、正确性决定或 rollout 谱系。

value_zh.html: 已核验

value.html: medium

Venue is therefore recorded conservatively as an ICLR 2026 submission / arXiv preprint. The current nine-author arXiv metadata is used, with the OpenReview authorship mismatch retained as an audit note. Official paper links are verified, but release artifacts and several implementation details remain unavailable.

value_zh.html: 官方 OpenReview 记录将 Submission 8937 标识为提交至 ICLR 2026，且未提供经核验的接收决定；较后的 arXiv 记录写 Under Review。因此发表场所被保守记录为 ICLR 2026 投稿 / arXiv 预印本。使用当前九作者 arXiv 元数据，并将 OpenReview 作者身份不匹配保留为审计注记。官方论文链接已核验，但发布产物与若干实现细节仍不可用。

arXiv and OpenReview identity are verified. No acceptance record, official code, paper-specific dataset, project page or Hugging Face release was verified; tokenizer, verifier and record-level lineage contracts remain partial or unknown.
